svg.title: A request becomes a useful result
svg.desc: Fictional example • Preparing a customer proposal You ask: Use de-business-kit. Prepare a proposal from these notes. Ask for anything missing. The assistant checks what is needed: The service and price are already in your notes. What delivery date did you agree with the client? You get a readable draft: Review the proposal. Missing details stay visible. A saved draft does not mean it was sent. Next chat: continue from your folder: Use de-business-kit. Read my saved progress. The date is confirmed. Update the proposal. Illustrated example, not a recorded conversation.
